The test image unambiguously shows the **bacterial streaming (ooze) test**: a tomato stem piece in a glass beaker, with brown vascular discoloration in the stem and milky white bacterial ooze streaming into the water. This is the classic diagnostic test for *Ralstonia solanacearum*. The Bacterial_Wilt reference collage contains images numbered 5606059 and 5606063 — the test image is numbered **5606064**, placing it squarely within that same image series. Southern_Bacterial_Wilt also shows the beaker test but uses different-sized/shaped containers and different image numbering ranges.
